CTET September Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the exam date for the post of Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September 2026 examination. Applications for the CTET September Online Form 2026 were accepted from 25 August 2026, to 01 September 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 12-13 December 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their CTET September Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.
